theme: Image caching: memory, disk and keys

terms.definition: A fast cache that keeps items in RAM, but it empties when the app closes.
terms.example: The memory cache shows the avatar right away.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let cache = NSCache<NSString, NSString>()
cache.setObject("img", forKey: "a")
print(cache.object(forKey: "a") ?? "none")

terms.definition: A cache that saves items in files, so they survive an app restart but load more slowly.
terms.example: The disk cache keeps images after a restart.

terms.definition: A unique name that you use to store and find one item in a cache.
terms.example: Use the image URL as the cache key.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let url = URL(string: "https://a.com/1.png")!
let key = url.absoluteString
print(key)

video.title: Memory Cache, Disk Cache & Cache Key | Day 224
video.description:
Learn to explain how an app keeps downloaded images close by: Memory Cache, Disk Cache & Cache Key, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Memory Cache - A fast cache that keeps items in RAM, but it empties when the app closes.
Disk Cache - A cache that saves items in files, so they survive an app restart but load more slowly.
Cache Key - A unique name that you use to store and find one item in a cache.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Memory Cache, Disk Cache & Cache Key | Day 224
landscape.description:
Explain Memory Cache, Disk Cache & Cache Key in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Memory Cache, Disk Cache, Cache Key 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Memory Cache - A fast cache that keeps items in RAM, but it empties when the app closes.
한국어: Memory Cache: 항목을 RAM에 두어 빠르지만 앱이 종료되면 비워지는 캐시

Disk Cache - A cache that saves items in files, so they survive an app restart but load more slowly.
한국어: Disk Cache: 항목을 파일로 저장해 앱을 다시 켜도 남지만 더 느리게 불러오는 캐시

Cache Key - A unique name that you use to store and find one item in a cache.
한국어: Cache Key: 캐시에서 항목 하나를 저장하고 찾을 때 쓰는 고유한 이름

dialogue.title: The flickering avatar

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, avatars flicker because we download them again and again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a memory cache. It keeps the images in RAM, so they show right away.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, an NSCache. But a memory cache empties when the app closes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then users wait again after every launch.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So add a disk cache too. It saves the images in files, like `file` in our code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is the disk cache as fast as the memory cache?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, it is slower. But it survives a restart.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do we find the right image in both caches?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With a cache key. Ours is `avatar-42`, and it is unique for each image.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used the user name before, and two users shared one image.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A good cache key is unique. Use the same cache key in the memory cache and the disk cache.
The memory cache shows the avatar right away.
